kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 158.48 = DRHP industry-average P/E of 28.10x (VST Tillers 33.34x, Indo Farm 27.62x, Escorts Kubota 23.35x, closing prices 11-Sep-2026, p. 156) x restated FY26 basic EPS of Rs 5.64 (p. 154). It is a reference point built only from the DRHP, not a price band; the peers are tractor and tiller makers, not implements makers.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: CFO positive in all three years: Rs 124.93 m / 130.15 m / 26.85 m (FY24/25/26); cumulative CFO/PAT 69.7% (281.93 / 404.39), on mixed standalone and consolidated bases. FY26 CFO/PAT 8.6%: CFO before working capital was Rs 619.53 m, inventory absorbed Rs 445.46 m and other assets Rs 281.35 m. CFO is struck before interest of Rs 101.63 m in FY26.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Business transfer agreements dated 27-Aug-2025 bought two promoter proprietorships (Rs 69.13 m from Dharam Singh, Rs 255.44 m from Jagatjit Singh) for shares at Rs 1,547 pre-bonus and pre-split (about Rs 33.63 per Rs 5 share), on a single registered valuer's report. The proposed Rs 716.64 m expansion is on 16.20 acres leased from Jagatjit Singh at Rs 0.08 m per month, +15% every three years (p. 129). Related-party loans and advances to promoters outstanding: Rs 45.00 m (Jagatjit Singh) and Rs 10.00 m (Dharam Singh) at 31-Mar-2026 (p. 95).

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: Goodwill Rs 4.55 m at 31-Mar-2026 against tangible net worth Rs 704.74 m. The proforma balance sheet at 31-Mar-2025 shows goodwill of Rs 65.66 m (p. 91) and a capital reserve of Rs 32.98 m at 31-Mar-2024; the restated FY26 balance sheet carries Rs 4.55 m. The DRHP does not reconcile the two treatments of the same acquisitions.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: FY26 top customer 25.21%, top 5 40.84%, top 10 50.04% of revenue; in FY25 the top customer (21.86%) was one of the acquired proprietorships. Top supplier 7.94%, top 10 40.53% of raw material purchases in FY26 (76.68% and 96.69% in FY25 and FY24 on restated basis). No long-term supply agreements (p. 23). Top three products (Super Seeder, Straw Reaper, Laser Land Leveller) = 64.40% of FY26 revenue (p. 450). Demand for flagship products depends on CRM and SMAM subsidy schemes (p. 56).

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: No qualification or emphasis of matter requiring adjustment (p. 344). Statutory auditor Anup Kumar Jain & Co. appointed 30-Sep-2024 on completion of the previous auditor's tenure (p. 98). Audit trail: accounting software of the parent had no database-level audit trail up to December 2025 (p. 343).

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: CARO 2020 audit trail: feature not enabled at database level for the parent company's accounting software up to December 2025. No adjustment to restated numbers.

focus.title: Monitoring agency
focus.detail: The company will appoint a monitoring agency before the RHP is filed (pp. 101, 152). Debt repayment object is Rs 185.00 m of borrowings not yet identified by lender. Directors Jagatjit Singh and Dharam Singh were appointed on 29-Sep-2020 while disqualified under the Companies Act (the DRHP states the disqualification subsisted to 31-Oct-2021); an adjudication application was filed on 11-Sep-2026 and is pending (p. 489). Personal guarantees and promoter property security for the borrowings were not tested in this screen.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -46.6% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.detail: Price band, offer expenses and general corporate purposes amount

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Interim (H1 FY27) financials; the audited record ends 31-Mar-2026 (195 days before this scan)

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Like-for-like FY26 vs FY25: FY25 restated (standalone) revenue Rs 959.26 m vs proforma Rs 2,537.60 m; proforma has no FY26 counterpart because FY26 already includes the acquired businesses

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Proforma employee cost rose from Rs 88.52 m (FY24) to Rs 259.35 m (FY25); the DRHP does not explain the step

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Goodwill Rs 65.66 m in the proforma FY25 balance sheet vs Rs 4.55 m in restated FY26; accounting treatment of the two acquisitions from promoter proprietorships

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Promoter loans and advances of Rs 55.00 m receivable at 31-Mar-2026: terms, rate, and whether repaid before listing

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Receivables ageing and provision policy (ECL provision charge Rs 34.90 m in FY26) not tested

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Contracted versus drawn promoter remuneration; promoters drew Rs 60.00 m in FY26 and nil in FY25

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Peer set is tractor and tiller makers (RoNW 4.4% to 11.3%); no direct listed comparable is identified by the issuer

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Dealer and subsidy-linked receivable exposure to CRM / SMAM schemes not quantified

focus.title: Data gap (medium)

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Pre-IPO placement of up to Rs 600 m: price and subscribers

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 22:1 bonus (allotted 27-May-2026) and a 1:2 split are applied to EPS and NAV for all years (EPS 5.64 / 1.42 / 0.57; NAV Rs 12.75 on 55,650,984 shares). The FY26 balance sheet share capital of Rs 12.10 m is the pre-bonus count of 1,209,804 shares of Rs 10 (p. 85); post-bonus and split there are 55,650,984 shares of Rs 5 (p. 112). Presentation point only.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 130.30 m on PBT of Rs 444.12 m = 29.3% in FY26 (statutory 25.17%); deferred tax is a credit of Rs 0.09 m. Cumulative current tax / PBT 26.1% over FY24-26 (147.09 / 562.64).

comfort.title: Revaluation reserve
comfort.detail: No revaluation reserve line in the restated balance sheet.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 71.70 m (income tax 0.18, GST 22.67, other 6.50, bank guarantees 42.35) = 10.1% of ICDR net worth of Rs 709.29 m. Litigation materiality threshold is the lowest of three tests, Rs 6.74 m (p. 488).

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Issue is made under Reg 6(2): not less than 75% of the Net Offer to QIBs because net tangible assets and net worth tests of Reg 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(c) are not met for the preceding three years. KPI EBITDA Rs 557.38 m reproduces from the P&L (PBT 444.12 + finance 101.63 + D&A 46.66 - other income 35.03). Total assets and total liabilities reproduce at Rs 3,188.36 m.

comfort.title: SME conditions
comfort.detail: Offer for sale of 3,100,000 shares by Jagatjit Singh, 6.3% of his 48,990,736 shares; about Rs 49.1 m at the Rs 158.48 reference = 14.1% of the Rs 3,000 m fresh issue. Test any OFS ceiling against the ICDR as in force when the RHP fixes the price.

strengths: Proforma revenue +63.1% in FY26 to Rs 4,139.7 m on units sold of 19,111 (+56.2%) (pp. 92, 87, 158)
Current tax 29.3% of PBT in FY26, above the 25.17% statutory rate (p. 87)
Interest coverage 5.03x and debt/equity 1.89x FY26, from 2.70x and 50.36x in FY24 (p. 158)
Estimated 13% value share in straw reapers and 30% / 15% / 12% of subsidy-scheme Super Seeder units in MP / Haryana / Punjab, issuer-commissioned report (p. 446)
Capacity utilisation 76.3% FY26: 18,219 units on 23,875 installed (pp. 267-268)
weaknesses: Operating cash flow Rs 26.85 m vs PAT Rs 313.90 m in FY26 (p. 88)
Top three products 64.40% of revenue (p. 450); top customer 25.21% (p. 36)
Other expenses rose to 18.94% of revenue from 12.46% proforma FY25 (pp. 87, 92)
Inventory 132 days and receivable 45 days in FY26 vs payable 106 days (p. 128)
Working capital object of Rs 1,100 m is 36.7% of the fresh issue; modelled inventory days stay at about 130 (pp. 124, 128)
opportunities: Indian farm equipment market Rs 1,397 bn in FY26 to Rs 1,876 bn by FY30, 7.7% CAGR, issuer-commissioned estimate (p. 250)
Rs 716.64 m Dehlon expansion adds a fabrication unit, utilities unit and R&D unit; no orders placed yet (pp. 129-130)
Presence in 20 states in FY26 vs 15 in FY25 and 10 in FY24 (p. 158)
Briquette and pellet machinery for crop residue conversion (p. 446)
threats: CRM and SMAM subsidy changes could cut demand for flagship products (p. 56)
Monsoon and rural-income cycles; fragmented holdings, 86% of operational holdings are small and marginal (CARE report, p. 241 of PDF)
Expansion site is 16.20 acres leased from a promoter at Rs 0.08 m per month (p. 129)
Erstwhile related parties still buy and sell with the company: Rs 164.91 m purchases and Rs 70.00 m sales FY26 (p. 94)
FY26 is the first consolidated year; no history of the combined business as a listed entity (pp. 301-302)
